import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
  return (g[True]-g[False]).mean(), g
e,g=est(w);print(e);print(g)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);B=[]
grp=[x for _,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
for i in range(2000):
  B.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in grp]))[0])
print(np.percentile(B,[2.5,97.5]))
for nm,d in [('high',w[w.date_confidence=='high']),('noother',w[~w.genre.isin(['other','collection'])]),('UK',w[w.origin=='UK']),('US',w[w.origin=='US']),('win1856-1896',w[(w.year>1855)&(w.year<1897)])]:
  print(nm,est(d)[0])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.agg(['mean','size']))
print(w.author_key.nunique())
"

import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['y']=w[c];w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
m=smf.glm('y~late+C(genre)+C(date_confidence)+C(origin)',data=w,family=__import__('statsmodels.api').api.families.Binomial()).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'])
w2=w[w.genre.isin(['adventure','domestic_realist','historical','juvenile'])]
g=w2.groupby(['genre','late']).y.mean().unstack();print((g[1]-g[0]).mean())
pp=p.merge(w[['work_id','year','genre']],on='work_id')
s=pp[pp.domains.apply(lambda d:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(d))]
print(s[s.year>=1876].sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).head(4)[['passage_id','genre','year']]);print(s[s.year<1876].head(2)[['passage_id','genre','year']])
"
